Help me split apartment chores for the week among the people who live here.

response.text: Happy to help with that, Dana! To make a fair split, could you tell me the names of the people living there and the specific chores you have in mind (e.g., dishes, trash, vacuuming)? Once I have that, I can create a rotating weekly schedule for everyone.
